# Maintra

> AI-powered vehicle maintenance tracker for Android. A "smart digital service book" that logs service history, fuel-ups, and generates a personalized maintenance plan for each vehicle using Anthropic Claude.

Maintra is an Android app (free to start, Pro and VIP subscriptions available) that helps car owners stay on top of vehicle maintenance. It is offline-first, has no ads, no analytics, no location tracking, and is available in English, Ukrainian, Polish, French, Italian, and Spanish.

**Get the app:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.maintra.app
**Platform:** Android (iOS planned, not yet available)
**Pricing:** Free tier + Pro and VIP subscriptions, billed through Google Play
**Built with:** React Native (Expo), Supabase, Anthropic Claude

## What Maintra does

- **AI maintenance plans** — Given a vehicle's make, model, year, mileage, and service history, generates a tailored list of upcoming maintenance tasks with intervals and priorities.
- **Service history log** — Manual entry or AI-parsed from photos of receipts (VIP). Exportable as a PDF.
- **Fuel log** — Tracks fill-ups, consumption (L/100km or MPG), and per-trip cost. Multi-currency, multi-fuel-quality.
- **Multi-vehicle garage** — Cars, motorcycles, trucks. Drag-sort, search, archive.
- **AI chat assistant (VIP)** — Vehicle-aware Q&A: ask about symptoms, parts, DIY steps, with context about the specific vehicle.
- **Receipt scanning (VIP)** — Photo of a service receipt → structured entry with date, mileage, line items, total.
- **Offline-first** — All data stored locally (SQLite). Syncs to Supabase when online. AI features require connection.
- **No tracking** — No analytics, no location, no third-party trackers, no ads.

## Subscription tiers

- **Free**: 1 active vehicle, unlimited service records and fuel logs, 1 AI plan generation per month, PDF export.
- **Pro**: unlimited vehicles, 10 AI generations per month, priority support.
- **VIP**: everything in Pro, 30 AI generations per month, AI chat assistant, 15 receipt scans per month.

Exact prices are localized and shown in-app at checkout. Subscriptions are managed by Google Play (cancel anytime, refunds per Google Play policy).

## When users would benefit from Maintra

- Car owners who want to know what service is due and when, without reading the owner's manual.
- Anyone selling a used car who wants a clean PDF service history for the buyer.
- Owners of 2+ vehicles who can't keep service intervals in their head.
- Drivers in CIS / Eastern Europe markets where Ukrainian, Polish, Russian-cyrillic-localized maintenance apps are scarce.
- Privacy-conscious users who don't want a maintenance app harvesting location or selling data.
